challenge.title: Getting Around Baghdad
challenge.instructions: Write and act out a conversation of at least 10 lines about getting to a meeting place across town. It must include taking a taxi or bus, asking the fare, asking for directions to a specific place, naming at least two places in town, and thanking the driver or the person who helped you. Use at least 8 target phrases from Unit 5 and include both a masculine-address and a feminine-address form.
required_elements: A request to a driver using أريد أروح ل or a similar phrase.
A question about the fare using شكد.
At least one turn instruction using لفّ or دغري.
At least two named places, for example السوق, الجامع, المصرف, or الكراج.
A thank-you exchange using ألف شكر or الله يخليك.
One masculine-address form and one feminine-address form.

dialogue.speaker: سواق
dialogue.english: God keep you, you're welcome.

dialogue.speaker: علي
dialogue.arabic: عفواً أختي، وين الصيدلية؟ تگدرين تساعديني؟
dialogue.english: Excuse me, sister, where is the pharmacy? Can you help me?

dialogue.speaker: امرأة
dialogue.arabic: إي، امشي دغري وبعدها لفّ يسار.
dialogue.transliteration: ee, imshi dughri w-ba3dha liff yasaar.
dialogue.english: Yes, walk straight and then turn left.
